newsitem.title: USA: CRI sets big dividend before dissolution.
newsitem.headline: CRI sets big dividend before dissolution.

text.p: CRI Liquidating REIT Inc on Wednesday it expected to distribute at least $53.5 million to shareholders as a quarterly dividend on March 31, prior to going out of business.
The record date for the dividend is March 20.
The real estate investment trust also scheduled a special April 23 meeting for shareholders of record date on March 10 to vote on its plan of liquidation.
The company previously said it intended to dispose of its remaining assets and dissolve in accordance with its business plan.
CRI said it recently sold its remaining whole mortgage loans for gross proceeds of about $54.7 million.

At the end of January, it had $53.5 million in cash from the sale (net of fees), cash and other assets with a book value of about $4.5 million and equity interests in three limited partnerships. Those interests have an aggregate tax basis value of about $3.7 million, though no book value.
The company said it would distribute other available cash in its dividend in addition to cash from the mortgage sale.
